stem.text: Scientists investigated the effect of increasing concentrations of an antibiotic on the development of antibiotic resistance in bacteria.

The scientists grew four groups of bacteria and added a different concentration of antibiotic to each group. The number of resistant bacteria and the total population of bacteria were measured at intervals for 24 hours for each group.

stem.text: Which statements are correct conclusions that can be made from the results of this investigation?

items: Increasing the concentration of antibiotic decreases the population of non-resistant bacteria at the end of 24 hours.
The proportion of antibiotic-resistant bacteria increases with increasing concentrations of antibiotics.
Increasing the concentration of antibiotic always increases the number of resistant bacteria.
